headline: Contested Fronts Stir as Base Lines Shift
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the sharpest change at LinnMercyHex, where activity has surged to ten base events in two hours and twenty-seven in twenty-four; eight bases became neutral, while six Colonial and three Warden captures were recorded. Its line now stands at ten Colonial-held bases and one neutral. StonecradleHex remains a principal contested sector, though its recent burst has slackened to no events in two hours and six in six; seventeen were logged across the day, leaving six Colonial and three Warden bases amid accelerating casualties. WeatheredExpanseHex likewise remains divided at six Warden and three Colonial bases, with two events in the latest two hours and fourteen daily, while losses and enlistments accelerate on both sides. StlicanShelfHex has quieted since the previous edition, recording two events in six hours and six in twenty-four around its five-Warden, four-Colonial split. MooringCountyHex retains eight daily events but none recently, and DeadLandsHex has five daily events with its eleven Colonial bases unchanged. Callahans Passage is fiercely active by casualty figures, yet reports no base events.
